# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This repository uses **Claude Code** as its primary AI development harness. For
canonical guidance — architecture overview, validation tiers, commit standards, file
rules, anti-patterns, and the new-vertical workflow — read:

- [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) — quick-reference cheat-sheet
- [`AGENT_WORKFLOW.md`](../AGENT_WORKFLOW.md) — step-by-step walkthrough
- [`docs/api-facts.yaml`](../docs/api-facts.yaml) — generated, CI-validated index of
  every endpoint's response shape, module name quirks, and helper status
- [`docs/adr/`](../docs/adr/) — Architecture Decision Records

## Validation before pushing

```bash
uv run poe agent-check  # Tier 2: format + lint + typecheck (~10s, before commit)
uv run poe check        # Tier 3: above + tests + facts-check (~30s, before PR)
```

Never use `--no-verify`, `noqa`, `type: ignore`, or skip a failing check. Fix at the
source. See CLAUDE.md "Zero Tolerance for Ignoring Errors".

## Generated files

Files under `frontapp_public_api_client/api/`, `frontapp_public_api_client/models/`, and
`client.py` / `client_types.py` / `errors.py` are generated by
`uv run poe regenerate-client`. The vendored OpenAPI spec (`docs/frontapp-openapi.yaml`)
and facts index (`docs/api-facts.yaml`) are similarly generated. **Never edit any of
these directly** — patch `scripts/vendor_spec.py` or regenerate.

## Conventional commits

```
feat(client): ...    # → frontapp-openapi-client minor
fix(mcp): ...        # → frontapp-mcp-server patch
docs: ...            # no release
```

Use `!` for breaking changes (`feat(client)!: ...`). See CLAUDE.md "Commit Standards"
for the full type / scope matrix.
